lines.title: 个人科研开展
lines.theme: 一个人如何用 AI 提速自己的研究
lines.theme_en: How one person uses AI to speed up their own research
lines.intro: 这条线讲个人科研中的两个 AI 技能：把论文与代码对照讲透的 paper-explainer，以及在会话之间交接上下文的 baton。一个负责把复杂的弄明白，一个负责把做了一半的接住。
lines.intro_en: This line covers two AI skills for individual research: paper-explainer, which explains papers side by side with their method and code, and baton, which hands context over between sessions. One makes the complicated understandable; the other picks up where you left off.

skills.name: paper-explainer · 科研领域 AI 导读
skills.name_en: paper-explainer · AI guide for research fields
skills.tagline: 陌生科研领域的入门向导：批量精读论文 PDF，按行文逻辑讲解，并生成可动态更新的知识图谱。
skills.tagline_en: An onboarding guide to unfamiliar research fields: batch deep-reads of paper PDFs, explains each along the paper's own logic, and generates a dynamically updated knowledge graph.
skills.purpose: 接触一个陌生领域，不再逐篇啃 PDF：把搜集到的若干篇论文交给它，每篇生成一份沿行文逻辑、由浅入深的讲解网页；全部读完后，再生成一张跨论文知识点关联的知识图谱网页；后续追加新论文，两个网页都会动态更新。
skills.purpose_en: Entering an unfamiliar field no longer means grinding through PDFs one by one: hand it the papers you have collected and it produces, for each, an explanation webpage that follows the paper's own structure from shallow to deep; once all are read, it generates a knowledge-graph webpage linking concepts across papers; when new papers are added later, both webpages update dynamically.
capabilities: 多 PDF 批量精读：每篇一份梗概 + 沿行文逻辑由浅入深的讲解网页
跨论文知识图谱：梳理各篇知识点之间的关联，独立 HTML 输出
增量更新：追加新论文后，单篇解析与知识图谱动态同步
capabilities_en: Multi-PDF batch deep reading: one overview plus a structured explanation webpage per paper
Cross-paper knowledge graph: maps how concepts across papers relate, standalone HTML output
Incremental updates: adding new papers keeps per-paper analyses and the knowledge graph in sync

skills.name: baton · 会话接力棒
skills.tagline: 把一次会话做了什么、卡在哪、结果与偏好落盘成接力棒，让下一个（多个）AI 会话直接接住上下文。
skills.tagline_en: Writes what a session did, where it got stuck, the results and your preferences into a relay baton, so the next AI session — or several at once — picks the context right up.
skills.purpose: AI 会话切换会丢失全部上下文。baton 把「做了什么、遇到什么困难、得到什么结果、以及个人偏好」写进一个 markdown 接力棒，交给下一个会话继续跑；接力棒文件多了，还支持合并汇总——既压缩后续会话的上下文输入，也让交接记录成为可管理的数据资产。
skills.purpose_en: Switching AI sessions loses all context. baton writes “what was done, what difficulties arose, what results came out, and personal preferences” into a markdown relay baton handed to the next session; as baton files accumulate they can be merged and consolidated — compressing context input for later sessions and turning handover records into a manageable data asset.
capabilities: 上下文迁移：落棒、接棒、并棒，交接「进展、困难、结果与偏好」
文件多了可合并汇总，压缩上下文输入，交接记录成为数据资产
Iron Rule：落盘前 git 核对真实状态；本仓库 .baton/ 已有 14 份
capabilities_en: Context migration: drop, grab and merge batons, handing over “progress, difficulties, results and preferences”
Merge and consolidate as files pile up; handover records become a data asset
Iron Rule: verify real state with git before dropping; this repo already holds 14 batons

products.desc: 多 PDF 精读产出的讲解网页：梗概、行文逻辑、公式与代码对照；配套跨论文知识图谱。
products.desc_en: Explanation pages from multi-PDF deep reading: overview, structure, formulas and code side by side; plus a cross-paper knowledge graph.

build.desc_en: Use and revise on real tasks: the 14 batons and explainer docs are themselves the iteration log.

lines.title: 团队科研协作
lines.theme: 一群人如何用 AI 对齐工作方式
lines.theme_en: How a team uses AI to align the way it works
lines.intro: 这条线讲团队协作中的两个抓手：meeting-to-wechat 把会议纪要压缩成微信群可用的精简消息，CONTRIBUTING.md 用约定式提交与 AI 智能体 SOP 规范整个仓库的协作。一个对齐信息，一个对齐代码。
lines.intro_en: This line covers two handles for collaboration: meeting-to-wechat compresses meeting minutes into a paste-ready WeChat group message, and CONTRIBUTING.md standardizes repo collaboration with conventional commits and an AI-agent SOP. One aligns information, the other aligns code.

skills.name: meeting-to-wechat · 会议纪要转微信群消息
skills.tagline: 从语音转写稿、会议纪要与时间轴中提取核心信息，生成可直接粘贴微信群的 300 字内消息。
skills.tagline_en: Distills the core information from voice transcripts, minutes and timelines into a message under 300 characters, ready to paste straight into a WeChat group.
skills.purpose: 会后整理纪要是最枯燥的体力劳动。把会议导出的 txt 三件套交给它，直接生成可粘贴微信群的 300 字内消息；而它产出的纪要梗概不只用于同步——还能作为每个队员的初始研究方案，成为后续任务展开的起点。
skills.purpose_en: Writing up minutes after a meeting is the dullest chore. Hand it the meeting's exported txt trio and it produces a paste-ready group message under 300 characters; the summary it produces does double duty — beyond syncing the group, it serves as each member's initial research plan and the starting point for follow-up tasks.
capabilities: 会议 txt 三件套直接生成微信可粘贴消息，免除会后纪要的体力劳动
纪要梗概一稿两用：同步到群里 + 作为每个队员的初始研究方案
专业名词知识库：16 位人名 + 50 余条术语，转写错误自动修正
capabilities_en: Meeting txt trio in, paste-ready WeChat message out — no more manual minute-writing after meetings
One summary, two uses: sync to the group + each member's initial research plan
Terminology knowledge base: 16 names + 50+ terms, auto-correcting transcription errors

skills.name: git 协作规范 · CONTRIBUTING.md
skills.tagline: 一份写给人和 AI 智能体的仓库协作规范：分支命名、约定式提交、PR 与 Code Review 流程。
skills.tagline_en: A repo collaboration spec written for humans and AI agents alike: branch naming, conventional commits, PR and code-review flow.
skills.purpose: 多人协作的仓库最容易乱在提交历史：「update」「fix bug」式的提交让回溯无从下手。CONTRIBUTING.md 统一了日常开发六步流程（同步、分支、提交、推送、PR、审查）、约定式提交格式（feat/fix/docs + 中文描述），以及 AI 智能体的操作 SOP 与禁止行为清单——AI 提交也必须过同一套规范。本仓库 90 条提交历史即为实践。
skills.purpose_en: Multi-person repos rot fastest in their commit history: “update” and “fix bug” commits make retrospection impossible. CONTRIBUTING.md unifies the six-step daily workflow (sync, branch, commit, push, PR, review), the conventional-commit format (feat/fix/docs + description), and an AI-agent SOP with a forbidden-actions list — AI commits go through the same spec. This repo's 90-commit history is the practice.
capabilities: 约定式提交：type 用英文、描述用中文，一行 50 字内、动词开头
分支命名五前缀：feature / fix / docx / refactor / experiment，保护规则强制 PR 合并
AI 智能体 SOP：环境检查、分支、提交、PR 全流程 + 8 条禁止行为（禁 force push 等）
capabilities_en: Conventional commits: English type + Chinese description, one line under 50 characters, verb-first
Five branch prefixes: feature / fix / docx / refactor / experiment; protection rules force PR merges
AI-agent SOP: environment check, branch, commit, PR end-to-end + 8 forbidden actions (no force push, etc.)

lines.title: 从个人到团队
lines.theme: 个人沉淀的能力，如何成为团队的基础设施
lines.theme_en: How individually distilled skills become team infrastructure
lines.intro: 这条线讲个人技能如何长成团队设施：meeting-to-wechat 的群消息只是入口，后续是完整的会议记录归档——每次会议按日期建目录、原始三件套落盘，再把讨论提炼成 M 系列方向文档，状态可追踪、方向互相引用。接力棒、知识图谱、会议纪要、M 系列文档——过程性信息就此沉淀为可复用的数据资产。
lines.intro_en: This line shows personal skills growing into team facilities: the WeChat message from meeting-to-wechat is only the entry point, followed by full meeting-record archiving — a dated directory per meeting with the raw trio stored verbatim, then discussion distilled into numbered M-series direction docs with trackable status and cross-references between directions. Batons, knowledge graphs, minutes, M-series docs — process information settles into reusable data assets.

skills.name: 会议记录归档 · meeting_records/
skills.tagline: 把每次会议沉淀为可回溯的目录：原始记录、方向文档、README 索引，状态一目了然。
skills.tagline_en: Settles every meeting into a traceable directory: raw records, direction docs, README index — status at a glance.
skills.purpose: 会开完了，信息不该停在群里。meeting_records/ 的归档规范是：每次会议一个日期目录，腾讯会议三件套（逐字稿、时间轴、纪要）原样落盘；讨论出的研究方向各自成档，材料齐全（文档 + notebook + 图 + 结果 JSON）；目录级 README 提供系列索引、状态总览与方向关系图。新成员进组，读归档即可接上上下文。
skills.purpose_en: When a meeting ends, the information should not die in the group chat. The archiving spec for meeting_records/: one dated directory per meeting, the Tencent-Meeting trio (transcript, timeline, minutes) stored verbatim; each research direction gets its own subdirectory with complete materials (doc + notebook + figures + result JSON); a directory-level README provides a series index, status overview and a direction-relationship map. A new member reads the archive and picks up the context.
capabilities: 按日期归档 + 原始三件套落盘，一切结论可回溯到会议原话
研究方向子目录材料齐全：markdown 主文档 + notebook + 图 + 结构化结果
README 索引：系列索引表、状态总览、方向关系图、更新日志，跨会议交叉引用
capabilities_en: Dated archiving + raw trio on disk: every conclusion traces back to the meeting's own words
Direction subdirectories with complete materials: markdown master doc + notebook + figures + structured results
README index: series table, status overview, direction map, changelog, cross-meeting references

skills.name: meeting-to-execution-plan-docs · M 系列任务文档
skills.tagline: 把会议梗概拆解为编号任务 M1、M2……每个 mission 一份可直接交给 AI Agent 执行的方向文档。
skills.tagline_en: Splits meeting summaries into numbered tasks M1, M2… one direction doc per mission, ready to hand straight to an AI Agent.
skills.purpose: 它直接接收 meeting-to-wechat 产出的会议梗概，把讨论内容拆解成若干个编号任务——M1（Mission 1）、M2……每个 mission 一份 markdown：写明问题动机与可能尝试的方向，拿到文档的 AI Agent 无需再读会议原文就能直接开工。目前已积累 M1–M13。
skills.purpose_en: It takes the meeting summary produced by meeting-to-wechat and splits the discussion into numbered tasks — M1 (Mission 1), M2… one markdown per mission: problem motivation plus promising directions to try, so an AI Agent holding the doc can start work without reading the original meeting. M1–M13 accumulated so far.
capabilities: 上游接 meeting-to-wechat：会议梗概直接拆解为编号任务 M1 / M2 / …
每个 mission 一份方向文档：动机 + 可能尝试的方向，可直接交给 AI Agent 执行
三种输入形态：有编号归类 / 无编号提炼并延续编号 / 核查补录
capabilities_en: Upstream of meeting-to-wechat: meeting summaries split into numbered tasks M1 / M2 / …
One direction doc per mission: motivation + promising directions, directly executable by an AI Agent
Three input forms: classified by existing number / distilled with continued numbering / audit backfill

build.title: 归档规范
build.desc: 约定目录结构：日期目录 + 方向子目录 + README 索引，材料齐全才算闭环。
build.desc_en: Agree the directory layout: dated directories + direction subdirectories + README index; complete materials close the loop.

build.title: 方向文档化
build.desc: 封装 meeting-to-execution-plan-docs：会议建议成为 M 系列执行计划，原话带时间戳可回溯。
build.desc_en: Package meeting-to-execution-plan-docs: meeting suggestions become M-series plans, original quotes timestamped and traceable.

build.title: 状态追踪闭环
build.desc: README 更新日志记录每次进展，跨会议交叉引用，新成员直接读归档接手。
build.desc_en: README changelog records every step; cross-meeting references; newcomers take over straight from the archive.

lines.title: 其他好用的 skill 推荐
lines.theme: 从工具到工具箱：值得一试的四个技能
lines.theme_en: From tools to a toolbox: four skills worth trying
lines.intro: 前三条线之外，还有四个日常高频使用的技能，按用途分两组：提示词优化与网页构建（prompt-enhancer、html-beautify），互联网调研与检索（agent-reach、anysearch）。本演示页就是 html-beautify 构建的。
lines.intro_en: Beyond the first three lines, four more skills in daily heavy use, grouped by purpose: prompt optimization and web building (prompt-enhancer, html-beautify), and internet research and retrieval (agent-reach, anysearch). This very demo page was built with html-beautify.

skills.name: prompt-enhancer · 提示词优化
skills.tagline: 把脑中不成熟、表达不清的想法，格式化拓展成 Agent 能规范执行的提示词。
skills.tagline_en: Formats fuzzy, half-formed ideas into prompts an Agent can execute reliably.
skills.purpose: 想表达的是一团模糊的想法，Agent 只能靠猜。这个技能对不成熟的提示词做格式化拓展与补充，让 Agent 更规范地执行；每份交付都附 What Changed 说明——用得越多，越清楚该怎么向 AI 叙述需求。
skills.purpose_en: What you want to express is a vague blob, so the Agent can only guess. This skill formats and expands immature prompts so the Agent executes more reliably; every delivery ships with a What Changed note — the more you use it, the clearer you get about telling AI what you need.
capabilities: 模糊想法格式化为结构提示词：角色、任务、动机、步骤、输出契约
三模式自动路由：第一性原理推导 / eval 驱动迭代 / 标准技巧工程
交付附 What Changed：间接教会用户如何向 AI 叙述需求
capabilities_en: Fuzzy ideas formatted into structured prompts: role, task, motivation, steps, output contract
Three auto-routed modes: first-principles derivation / eval-driven iteration / standard technique engineering
Deliveries include What Changed: indirectly teaching you how to phrase requirements to AI

skills.name: html-beautify · 网页美化与构建
skills.tagline: 网页渲染优化与打磨的一站式技能；用得最多的是从零构建一个新网页。
skills.tagline_en: A one-stop skill for rendering optimization and page polish; what I use most is building a new page from scratch.
skills.purpose: 它整合多个上游设计技能与大量高级 HTML 素材库，既能做渲染优化与网页打磨，也能从零构建：把需求交给它，它先从素材库检索相似度最高的模板作为候选，再基于这些高级模板定制出适配本次需求的网页。本演示页就是这么来的。
skills.purpose_en: It fuses several upstream design skills and a large library of premium HTML assets; it can optimize rendering and polish pages as well as build from zero: give it a requirement and it first retrieves the closest templates from the asset library as candidates, then tailors one of those premium templates to the need. This demo page is exactly that.
capabilities: match 流程：从 HTML 素材库检索相似度最高的模板作为候选
基于高级模板定制适配需求的网页，也支持从零设计
网页渲染优化与打磨；交付 DESIGN.md + finish review 验收
capabilities_en: match flow: retrieves the closest templates from the HTML asset library as candidates
Tailors premium templates to the requirement, or designs from scratch
Rendering optimization and polish; ships DESIGN.md + finish review acceptance

skills.name: agent-reach · 互联网能力路由器
skills.tagline: 登录类平台资源的路由器：小红书、微博、B 站……一个入口覆盖 15 个平台。
skills.tagline_en: A router for login-gated platforms: Xiaohongshu, Weibo, Bilibili… one entry covering 15 platforms.
skills.purpose: 很多高质量信息只存在于需要登录的客户端里：小红书、微博、B 站……agent-reach 把这些平台统一成一张路由表，借助社交软件的推荐机制，能高效搜到感兴趣领域的知识——比如 AI 圈的最新动态。
skills.purpose_en: Lots of high-quality information exists only inside login-required clients: Xiaohongshu, Weibo, Bilibili… agent-reach unifies them into one routing table; leaning on social platforms' recommendation machinery, it efficiently surfaces knowledge in a field you care about — say the latest moves in the AI scene.
capabilities: 覆盖登录类平台：小红书、微博、B 站等 15 个平台统一路由
借社交平台推荐机制，高效获取 AI 圈等领域的圈内消息
doctor 体检 + 失败重试链，多后端自动路由
capabilities_en: Covers login-gated platforms: Xiaohongshu, Weibo, Bilibili and more — 15 platforms, one route
Rides social-platform recommendations to pull insider news from fields like the AI scene
doctor checkup + failure-retry chain, multi-backend auto routing

skills.name: anysearch · 实时搜索引擎
skills.tagline: 管「广度」的搭档：通用 + 垂直域实时搜索，与 agent-reach 的「深度」互为兜底。
skills.tagline_en: The “breadth” partner: general + vertical real-time search, backing up agent-reach's “depth”.
skills.purpose: agent-reach 与 anysearch 是一对互补：前者是平台路由器——复用登录态进小红书/微博/B 站，读帖子、评论、视频字幕等深层内容；后者是搜索引擎——通用网页、垂直域（金融/学术/法律/安全）与结构化标识符（Stock/CVE/DOI/IATA），batch_search 批量并行、匿名免登录。一个管「找到有哪些东西」，一个管「把东西读出来」，互相兜住对方的盲区。
skills.purpose_en: agent-reach and anysearch are a complementary pair: the former is a platform router — reusing logged-in sessions into Xiaohongshu/Weibo/Bilibili to read posts, comments, video subtitles and other deep content; the latter is a search engine — general web, vertical domains (finance/academic/legal/security) and structured identifiers (Stock/CVE/DOI/IATA), with batch_search parallel queries, anonymous and login-free. One finds “what's out there”, the other “reads it out”; each covers the other's blind spot.
capabilities: 广度担当：通用网页 + 垂直域结构化（金融/学术/法律/安全）+ Stock/CVE/DOI/IATA 标识符
batch_search 一次并行 N 个查询、可混域；无需登录、匿名可用
与 agent-reach 互为 fallback：不可用时切换，中国网络下 agent-reach 内置 codeload/atom 绕行
标准协作流：anysearch 广谱侦察 → 定位深挖目标 → agent-reach 登录态读正文 → 汇总报告
capabilities_en: Breadth: general web + structured verticals (finance/academic/legal/security) + Stock/CVE/DOI/IATA identifiers
batch_search runs N queries in parallel across mixed domains; no login needed, anonymous access
Mutual fallback with agent-reach: switch when unavailable; agent-reach ships codeload/atom detours for China networks
Standard combo: anysearch broad recon → pin deep-dive targets → agent-reach reads full text with logged-in sessions → synthesize the report

closing.heading: 四条线，汇于一处
closing.text: 个人科研中的 AI 能力，经由团队协作被放大；团队协作的公共工具，反过来滋养每个人的研究。从接力棒到知识图谱、从会议纪要到 M 系列文档——过程性信息沉淀为可复用的数据资产，全部有可打开的真实文件佐证。如果这套实践与贵司的业务场景有交汇之处，期待进一步沟通。
closing.text_en: AI capability in individual research is amplified through team collaboration; the team's shared tools in turn nourish each member's research. From batons to knowledge graphs, from minutes to M-series docs — process information settles into reusable data assets, all backed by openable real files. If any of this practice intersects with your business scenarios, I look forward to talking further.
